tests.goal: Confirm that an agent can be built on {{MODEL_NAME}} ({{PROVIDER_NAME}})

steps.action: Open the Agent Builder.
Enter a name and instructions, and pick the model {{MODEL_NAME}} ({{PROVIDER_NAME}}.
Save.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent is saved
It appears in the agent list

steps.action: Query the Agent.
acceptanceCriteria: You get a successful response.

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent's instructions can be updated and are followed

steps.action: Open an existing agent.
Change its instructions.
Save, then chat with it.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent follows the updated instructions

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent with a skill added uses that skill

steps.action: Edit an agent.
Set the Skills mode to "Selected" and add a skill using "Add skill".
Save the agent.
Start a new chat with the saved agent and send a prompt relevant to that skill.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent invokes the skill

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent with an MCP tool added uses that tool

steps.action: Edit an agent.
Add a tool from the MCP gateway.
Save and chat with a relevant prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent calls the MCP tool and uses its results

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent can run code

steps.action: Edit an agent with Run Code enabled.
Ask it a question that needs a calculation or code to answer.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent runs code and returns the result

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent that is no longer needed can be deleted

steps.action: Open Agent Builder.
Delete an existing agent.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent is removed from the list

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent's work survives a page refresh mid-run

steps.action: Start a long-running agent task.
Refresh the page before it finishes.
acceptanceCriteria: The run is still in progress or completes after the refresh
No work is lost

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent can be restored to a previous version

steps.action: Open Agent Builder and edit an agent.
Make a change, then save and exit.
Return to edit the agent and open the Versions list.
On a previous version, click its Restore (rotate) button, then confirm in the restore dialog.
acceptanceCriteria: The restore confirmation dialog shows the version being restored
The agent now has the restored version's settings

tests.goal: Confirm that a user with view access to a shared agent can chat with it but not edit it

steps.action: Ensure the target agent has been shared with "Viewer" permissions.
Open Agent Marketplace.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent is present

steps.action: Start a chat with the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: The chat works

steps.action: Open Agent Builder.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent is not listed

tests.goal: Confirm that a user with edit access to a shared agent can edit it

steps.action: Ensure the target agent has been shared with "Editor" permissions.
Open Agent Builder.
Edit the agent and save.
Start a chat with the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent can be edited and saved
The chat uses the saved edits

tests.goal: Confirm that a user with owner access to a shared agent can share it

steps.action: Ensure the target agent has been shared with "Owner" permissions.
Open Agent Builder.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent is listed

steps.action: Try to share the agent.
acceptanceCriteria: The agent can be shared

tests.goal: Confirm that the Agent Marketplace shows the new categories and files uncategorised agents under General

steps.action: Open the Agent Marketplace.
acceptanceCriteria: These tabs are displayed: General, Pursue & Shape, Discover & Define, Build & Deliver, Produce & Assure, Resource & Grow People, All
The old HR, R&D, Finance, IT, Sales and After Sales tabs are not displayed

steps.action: Create a new agent without selecting a category.
Save the agent and return to the Agent Marketplace.
acceptanceCriteria: The new agent appears under General
No category is missing, legacy, duplicated or incorrectly assigned

tests.goal: Confirm that sharing an agent or skill shows a publication prompt linking to a form

steps.action: Share an agent or skill.
acceptanceCriteria: A publication prompt appears directly under the people picker

steps.action: Click the link in the prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: The link opens the form

tests.goal: Confirm that an agent's avatar loads in the agent selector row and the selected model header

steps.action: Create an agent with a profile picture (avatar).
acceptanceCriteria: The avatar loads in both the agent selector row and the selected model header when the image URL requires authentication
